full_text: The sender identifies TracFone's June 6 response as a duplicate of May 30/31 correspondence. He reiterates that TracFone has admitted to a technical failure regarding secure-boot partitions and shifts the burden to Motorola. He formally requests TracFone to stop sending duplicate letters unless they provide a substantive technical update or hardware replacement.
